recommendations.title: PUE 1.072 vs best-achieved 1.019
recommendations.action: Overhead is 74.0% above this facility's own best demonstrated performance (121.0 MWh in 30 days, about 1472 MWh/yr if sustained). Compare current control settings with the best-performing period. Note: the best-achieved baseline includes the period before the overhead step-change on 2024-03-28, so most of this gap is that change (see the commissioning-review recommendation).

recommendations.title: Commissioning review: overhead step-change from 2024-03-28
recommendations.action: Overhead ran 181 kW above expected for 100 h (18.1 MWh). Confirm whether this followed an intended change (new equipment, setpoints, fan-wall speeds). If not intended, revert or re-tune.

recommendations.title: HVAC now 80% of overhead (was 12% a year earlier)
recommendations.action: Review fan-wall, fan-coil and make-up-air-unit operation: HVAC power grew from 10 kW to 188 kW over the year.
